title: Score-based diffusion models for accelerated MRI
layout_note: Top row: a chain of square image thumbnails from pure noise (x_T ~ N) through x_{t+2} … x_{t-1} to the clean scan x_0, linked by thick navy block arrows, under one long cyan 'Reverse SDE' arrow. Bottom left: the aliased measured image y, whose dashed lines rise into each step. Bottom right: one step (x_{t+1} → x_t) pulled out by a dashed green arrow into a green rounded box.
grouping: The single expanded step is a rounded container with a green outline; inside it four tall vertical bars stand side by side: Predictor (mint), Data consistency (grey-blue), Corrector (light cyan), Data consistency (grey-blue), so the two DC bars share one colour.
shapes_depth: Real MR images carry the whole top row and the measurement; operations are flat tall bars with rotated bold labels and no outline. Thick dark block arrows for the sampling chain, thin dashed arrows for conditioning on y and for the zoom into the step. Math labels (x_T, x_t, y) in bold italic above each thumbnail.
proposed_highlight: The data-consistency steps inserted between predictor and corrector are shown as their own bars in the expanded step, and the measurement y is drawn feeding every step of the chain.
lesson: The sampling chain is a row of real image thumbnails going from noise to the clean scan under one long process arrow, with the measured aliased image below sending dashed conditioning lines up into the steps.
notes: venue Medical Image Analysis from Semantic Scholar ('Medical Image Anal.'; venue_source semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (2110.05243), as Semantic Scholar also lists. Sans-serif labels.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: the reverse SDE as a row of real MR images from pure noise x_T to the clean x_0, joined by thick navy arrows under one long light-blue 'Reverse SDE' arrow

relations.form: seven image tiles left to right (x_T, x_t+2, x_t+1, x_t, x_t-1, x_0) with ellipses for skipped steps, noise decreasing visibly
the aliased measurement image y sits under x_T and sends dotted navy lines up into the arrows between steps
a green dotted line drops from the x_t+1 arrow into a green rounded box below the row that expands one step
inside the green box four tall bars left to right: Predictor -> Data consistency -> Corrector -> Data consistency, with y entering the box and x_t leaving on a dashed arrow

channels.colour: navy = sampling arrows and measurement lines; green = the zoomed step (callout line, box outline, Predictor bar); light blue = Corrector; grey-blue = both data-consistency bars
channels.shape: image tiles = states, tall rounded bars = sub-steps
channels.line: thick solid arrows = diffusion steps, dotted = measurement injection and the zoom callout, dashed = the step's output
channels.frame: one green rounded frame = the inside of a single step

quality.strengths: every state is a real image, so the noise-to-image progression and the aliased measurement are visible as data; y enters each step from below on its own lines rather than a single wire; the zoom box makes the predictor-corrector-with-data-consistency structure explicit
quality.weaknesses: the zoomed step's output x_t is a dashed arrow to empty space, not tied back to the x_t tile; dotted lines carry both measurement injection and the zoom callout; the detail box shows no data between sub-steps and y's entry into each data-consistency bar is not drawn

insights.structure: A top row of seven square MR thumbnails (x_T noise through x_{t+2}...x_{t-1} to x_0) forms the reverse-SDE chain, and below it at the bottom right one step (x_{t+1} to x_t) opens into a green rounded box holding four tall bars: Predictor, Data consistency, Corrector, Data consistency.
insights.data: Every state is a real knee MR image whose noise fades left to right, and the aliased measurement y is a real image at bottom left whose dotted navy lines rise into each step arrow and run into the expanded box.
insights.emphasis: A single long cyan 'Reverse SDE' arrow over the chain names the process, and the zoom-out box with a green outline and colour-coded bars (mint predictor, cyan corrector, the two DC bars sharing grey-blue) carries the method's contribution.
insights.flow: Left to right on thick navy block arrows across the top; a green dashed line drops from the x_{t+1} arrow into the step box, which runs left to right with thin black arrows and exits as x_t on a dashed arrow.
insights.avoid: The dotted y lines join only two of the step arrows and then trail off into '...', so it is unclear that y conditions every step; draw the conditioning into all steps or say so.

arrangement.units: a chain of unenclosed image thumbnails above, and one green rounded box with four flat bars as the zoomed-in step
arrangement.inputs_as: real MR images: pure-noise x_T at top left and the aliased measurement y at bottom left
arrangement.shared: y feeds every reverse step by dotted lines
